text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion delivered a magnificent 
performance in the Osaka Hai as well. Yet, 
her usual sense of "fun" had vanished from 
her running...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion realized she was so backed 
into a corner that she could no longer 
keep up appearances. And so, she poured 
out her true feelings to her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She felt sad that the fun times had to 
end— Sad that a dream-like time would 
vanish like a real dream and be forgotten 
by everyone...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion smiles, saying she feels 
refreshed after speaking her mind. Her 
Trainer, however, is left wondering if 
things can truly stay as they are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With their own feelings held in their 
hearts, their next race is decided to be 
the Takarazuka Kinen, the Grand Prix race 
where popular umamusume chosen by fan vote 
gather...
